_: Every piece of this site that is borrowed from somewhere else: a figure the engine computes, a screen of the webapp rebuilt in code, a report the engine returned, sample data invented to look like either. For each: where it sits, where its truth lives, how it is refreshed, and when it last was. tools/refresh.mjs reads this; --check holds it to the pages in CI, --report says what has moved in the sources since each piece was refreshed, and a plain run regenerates what has a generator. Edit the dates with --stamp, not by hand. Commits under a piece's sources are informational when every fact it states still holds or when its regenerated output is identical; they call for a hand otherwise.

ui.generated: the markup is written by a tool from an export
ui.drawn: the markup was rebuilt by hand from screenshots of the product

data.generated: written by a tool from the engine or the workspace, never typed
data.replayed: the engine's real output for one request, vendored with the request
data.copied: typed by hand from a source that exists; goes stale when the source moves
data.invented: sample data with no source; stale only when the product changes shape
data.live: fetched when the page is viewed; nothing is vendored

_fact_kinds.enum-count: the number of members of a z.enum in a webapp file on origin/main equals `expect`
_fact_kinds.contains: a webapp file on origin/main still carries each string in `texts`
_fact_kinds.export: a value read from a fresh engine export (`from`: science-facts or engine-trace) at `path` equals `expect`; `reduce` may be length or sum-lengths; [*] maps over an array

_sanity: For a generated piece, paths in a fresh export that must not be empty, zero, or less than half of the site's copy. A probe that reports nothing where the site shows something is a broken probe until proven otherwise (workspace CLAUDE.md, Measurement Discipline); the piece is reported as not measured and nothing is written.
